description: AI Stethoscope - Preprocessing Configuration for Multi-Task Backbone

acoustic_band.description: Preserves clinical cardiac (20-800 Hz) and respiratory (100-2000 Hz) auscultation frequencies

high_pass_filter.description: Eliminates sub-audible chest contact friction and sensor baseline drift

resampling.description: Band-limited sinc interpolation compatible with pretrained audio foundation backbones

amplitude_normalization.description: Scales maximum absolute amplitude to 0.95 to prevent clipping in 16-bit PCM

log_mel_spectrogram.description: 128 Mel frequency bands over 313 temporal frames
